Three Streams. One Integrated Capital Forum
Less Than Two Weeks Left to Book your Place!

 

As the lines blur between energy, digital infrastructure, and core infrastructure – where are the new investment opportunities emerging from increasingly interconnected asset classes?

 

Infra Energy Finance: USA 2026 brings this convergence to life, dedicating three distinct streams under one roof. Powered by our market-leading data and intelligence, the event connects the USA’s most active project sponsors, fund managers, LPs, and lenders to explore opportunities emerging at the intersection of energy, technology, and infrastructure, and how deals are being originated and executed in an increasingly competitive market.

 

View the agenda and list of confirmed speakers here >>
 

Green Street Infrastructure subscribers have access to an exclusive 20% discount on delegate tickets. Simply enter the code Subs20%IEF26 at checkout to secure your subscriber rate.

Register Now
Why Three Streams?

Stream 1: Financing Energy Projects

As demand surges from AI, data centres, manufacturing, and electrification, the energy sector - especially reliable and resilient renewable assets - remains a critical enabler of growth. Understanding how power generation intersects with infrastructure and technology is key to identifying the next generation of investment opportunities.

 

Sessions Include:

- Financing Next-Gen Technologies: Deciphering Fact from Fiction 
- Private Equity Investors: Driving Growth or Repackaging Value?
- Investing in a OBBBA World: A Brave New World. 
- Is Now the Right Time to be Flooding into Battery Storage Solutions?

 

Speakers Include:

Stream 2: Financing TMT Projects

 Digital infrastructure is driving unprecedented demand for energy while accelerating the digitalisation of infrastructure assets. As technology, energy, and infrastructure converge, investors who understand the opportunities emerging at this intersection will be best positioned to capitalise on a once-in-a-generation investment cycle.

 

Sessions Include:

- How Digital Infrastructure Became ‘Core’ 
- The Green Elephant in the Room: Sustainability in Digital Infrastructure
- Doom or Boom: Can Financing Keep Up with Demand? 
- Behind-the-Meter Power & Data: Who Really Wins?

 

Speakers Include:

Stream 3: Financing Infrastructure Projects

Infrastructure provides the foundations that enable growth - from water facilities, transport systems, and industrial facilities. Core infrastructure remains the backbone upon which the next generation of energy and digital projects in order to be developed with speed and scale.

 

Sessions Include:

- Is There Really an Infrastructure Opportunity Set, or Just Capital Chasing Headlines?
- Do Ports and Airports Deserve Their Premium Valuations?
- Charting Bankability in Water: Unlocking Scale Through Consolidation and Platforms
- Mobility Without Pricing: Can Transport Ever Be Fully Financeable?

 

Speakers Include:
